subject: Television & Streaming
title: The Telenovela: Latin America's Gift to TV
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Telenovela: Latin America's Gift to TV.

hook.text: Telenovelas air nightly for months, feature dramatic plot twists, and end definitively.

buildup.text: Unlike American soap operas that run indefinitely, telenovelas have a planned ending.

discovery.text: Brazilian, Mexican, and Colombian telenovelas reach billions globally.

twist.text: Telenovelas address class inequality, corruption, and domestic violence while wrapping them in romance and spectacle.

climax.text: The telenovela is television's most democratically consumed format.

punchline.text: The world's most-watched stories come from Latin America.

quiz.question: How do telenovelas differ structurally from American soap operas?
options: Telenovelas have planned endings with complete story arcs, while American soaps run indefinitely
